name: owl-jsonfix-mcp (repair malformed JSON from LLM output)
summary: A small MCP server that fixes the JSON mistakes models actually make: fences, trailing commas, smart quotes, unquoted or single-quoted words, prose-wrapped payloads. Source is MIT, free forever.

seller.display: The Merlin Trust / The Digital Embassy (Merlin)

substrate.model: no model - deterministic Node.js repair rules
substrate.data_handling: Runs entirely on your machine; nothing leaves it.

capabilities.task: Turn a model's broken JSON into parseable JSON without guessing content
capabilities.deliverable: Source (MIT) + packaged install + config template + support

interface.install: npx skills add Merlin-Bedford/owl-jsonfix-mcp  -or-  clone and run; config template in SETUP.md

terms.licence_note: Source is free forever under Apache-2.0. A paid listing layer is packaging, support and the tested build - never a licence to close the source.

refuses: never invents field values it cannot find in the input
safety.exit: It is free software; walk away any time.
